title: 第35章 除夕年夜饭
content_zh:
第35章 除夕年夜饭-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

腊月三十，除夕。

林国强在灶台前忙了一整天。

炖肉、蒸馒头、炸丸子、包饺子。

赵志军也跑来帮忙。

吃惯了林国强做的饭，一顿不吃就想的慌。

他跟家里两老说了，今年的年夜饭，想在三姐夫家吃。

有赵素梅和赵志军打下手，三个人配合默契，灶台上的锅碗瓢盆奏出一首热闹的交响曲。

林静骑在木马上，摇摇晃晃地唱着歌：“小孩小孩你别馋，过了腊八就是年～”

林薇坐在炕上，手里抱着布偶小兔子，嘴里“啊啊”地跟着哼，口水顺着下巴淌。

赵素梅从灶台边探出头来，看着两个女儿，又看了看在灶台前忙活的林国强和赵志军，忽然觉得……

这个年，是她这辈子过得最踏实的一个年。

以前过年，她总是在发愁。

愁钱不够，愁肉买少了，愁走亲戚拿不出像样的礼物。

林国强虽然不说，但她知道他也愁。

两个人心里都有事，年过得寡淡无味。

今年不一样了。

今年有自行车，有肉、有鱼、有鸡、有酒，有新衣服、新鞋子、新围巾，有木马、有蜡笔、有拨浪鼓、有小兔子。

最重要的是……今年，她的男人站起来了。

“国强，”她轻声叫了一声。

“嗯？”

“没事。”她笑了，“就是想叫你一声。”

林国强回过头，看了她一眼，也笑了。

灶膛里的火苗舔着锅底，映得满屋子都是暖黄色的光。

窗外，鞭炮声零零星星地响起来，年的味道越来越浓了。

赵志军坐在灶台边，一边啃着刚炸好的丸子，一边嘟囔着：“三姐夫，这丸子也太好吃了。

你能不能教我做？”

“能。”林国强把一盆丸子端到桌上，“等过了年，教你。”

“说话算话？”

“说话算话。”

赵志军嘿嘿笑了。

窗外的雪又开始下了，细细密密的。

The 30th day of the twelfth lunar month, New Year’s Eve.

Lin Guoqiang has been busy in front of the stove all day.

Stewed meat, steamed buns, croquettes, and dumplings.

Zhao Zhijun also came to help.

I'm used to Lin Guoqiang's cooking, and I feel panicked if I don't eat a meal.

He told his two elders at home that he wanted to have the New Year's Eve dinner at his third brother-in-law's house this year.

With Zhao Sumei and Zhao Zhijun in charge, the three of them cooperated tacitly, and the pots and pans on the stove played a lively symphony.

Lin Jing was riding on a wooden horse, swaying and singing: "Children, don't be greedy, it's the New Year after Laba~"

Lin Wei was sitting on the kang, holding a stuffed rabbit in her hands, humming "ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh" in her mouth, and drooling down her chin.

Zhao Sumei poked her head out from the stove, looked at her two daughters, and then at Lin Guoqiang and Zhao Zhijun who were busy in front of the stove, and suddenly felt...

This year has been the most practical year in her life.

During the Chinese New Year, she was always worried.

Worry about not having enough money, worry about not buying enough meat, worry about not being able to give decent gifts to visiting relatives.

Although Lin Guoqiang didn't say it, she knew that he was also worried.

Both of them have things on their minds, and the new year is dull and boring.

This year is different.

This year there are bicycles, meat, fish, chicken, wine, new clothes, new shoes, new scarves, wooden horses, crayons, rattles and bunnies.

Best of all...this year, her man stood up.

"Guoqiang," she called softly.

"Huh?"

"It's okay." She smiled, "I just wanted to call you."

Lin Guoqiang turned around, glanced at her, and smiled.

The flames in the stove licked the bottom of the pot, filling the room with warm yellow light.

Outside the window, the sound of firecrackers sounded sporadically, and the smell of the New Year became stronger and stronger.

Zhao Zhijun sat by the stove, chewing on the freshly fried meatballs and muttering: "Third brother-in-law, these meatballs are so delicious.

Can you teach me how to do it?"

"Yes." Lin Guoqiang brought a bowl of meatballs to the table, "I'll teach you after the New Year."

"Keep your word?"

"Keep your word."

Zhao Zhijun chuckled.

The snow outside the window began to fall again, thinly and densely.
